purpose: Must-accept authoring witnesses for generic mutations that are lawful for the complement-tiling input domain. These are not sampled frequency or universal-induction claims.

cases.name: base_multicolor
cases.lawful_reason: Both zero and nonzero cells are present; arbitrary nonzero masks are admitted.

cases.name: zero_modal_singleton
cases.lawful_reason: One cell differs from the modal background, while zero and nonzero both remain present.

cases.name: zero_modal_short_line
cases.lawful_reason: A short line on the modal background retains both zero and nonzero cells.

cases.name: zero_modal_solid_2x2
cases.lawful_reason: A 2x2 patch on the modal background retains both zero and nonzero cells.

cases.name: nonzero_modal_singleton
cases.lawful_reason: One cell differs from the modal background, while zero and nonzero both remain present.

cases.name: nonzero_modal_short_line
cases.lawful_reason: A short line on the modal background retains both zero and nonzero cells.

cases.name: nonzero_modal_solid_2x2
cases.lawful_reason: A 2x2 patch on the modal background retains both zero and nonzero cells.

cases.name: cell_permutation
cases.lawful_reason: A cell permutation preserves dimensions, the palette, and zero/nonzero presence.

cases.name: square_transpose
cases.lawful_reason: Transposition preserves a lawful mask within the dimension bounds.

cases.name: nonzero_color_swap
cases.lawful_reason: Swapping nonzero labels preserves the law; the first nonzero determines the new output color.

cases.name: lawful_2x2_stomp
cases.lawful_reason: This 2x2 stomp leaves both zero and nonzero cells; stomps removing the last of either would be rejected.

cases.name: minimum_row
cases.lawful_reason: The smallest legal one-row input has area two and both presence classes.

cases.name: minimum_column
cases.lawful_reason: The smallest legal one-column input has area two and both presence classes.
